free_tier.stated: Free tier: 5 GB per transfer (registered, free), 2 GB per transfer (Light, no registration). '1回の転送容量' is 無制限 only on the 330/550-yen business plan. The site's own headline says 無料無制限. The plan table contradicts it. No total storage: '転送容量は1回に転送できる最大容量となり、何度でもご利用いただけます'.

retention.stated: Retention 3 days guest, 7 days free registered, 30 days business

egress.terms: No metered egress; free tiers are ad-supported, business tier is ad-free.

record.tooling: Web form; no API, no rclone backend.
record.chaining: 5 GB x unlimited sends, but 7-day retention on free means chaining is strictly a re-send loop, not accumulation.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap 5 GB (free) / 2 GB (guest). Retention 3 days guest, 7 days free registered, 30 days business. Free tier gets throttled transfer speed (`△` vs `〇`).
record.reliability_note: Running since 2004, ~3M users/month, run by 株式会社ファルコ. Stable, but the 無料無制限 headline on the marketing page is marketing. The plan table is the truth.

evidence.proved: free plan '1回の転送容量 ~~2GB~~ 5GB', 'データ保管期間 ~~3日間~~ 7日間', business plan '無制限' / '30日間'
2024-03-04 changelog: '500MB→2GB ライトプラン', '2GB→5GB フリープラン'
page title claims '無料無制限の大容量ファイル送信'
